verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents an official MCP server that lets Claude AI 'perform a range of banking and payment operations on your behalf.' One concrete tool is shown: create-truelayer-payment-link. Natural-language operation therefore works only through a third-party AI assistant, not a native natural-language interface. Missing for 10: a first-party or native natural-language interface, documentation of the full range of operations available through natural language beyond payment links, support for assistants other than Claude, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work in practice.
